notes.title: Game Update.
notes.notes:
Salam alaikum batyrs and jigitki. 😎

We’ve prepared an update for NEED FOR SCREAMM:

1. Fixed bugs causing the cat to get stuck.

2. Fixed a critical bug related to saving part of the baby crib toy.

3. Fixed a visual display bug.

4. Improved the behavior of jumpscares.

5. Improved monster attack logic.

6. Enhanced sound system performance.

7. Various minor improvements and fixes.
